_comment: sim-robust-plan-deadline-pacing-v1 bounded GPU proof config for the integration lane (twin-robot-in-store-boot-v1). Purpose: prove that the manipulation host's PLANNING-phase per-move deadline (ik / plan_accept / plan_result) is now on the SIM clock, so a render-paced slow-but-alive cuMotion plan is NEVER mis-read as a move_group crash and the crash-retry budget is never burned on a healthy plan. This is the coldlive4 failure (host-stack.log: three 'MOVE_DEADLINE_FAULT clock=wall ... state=plan_accept' lines, each over by ~0.03-0.10 s, each followed by 'MOVE_GROUP_CRASH_RETRY plan-result wall-deadline ... resending plan goal (retry 1/3 -> 3/3)', with ZERO 'process has died' lines -> budget exhausted -> MANIP_HOST_FAILED 'host emergency stop' at ~sim 24 s). Builds on PR 225/226/227: real move_group deaths still recover via the server-down paths (positive death evidence), and a SIM-deadline miss still holds-not-e-stops (PR 227 _fail_hold).
_root_cause: The fully-honest live_pose transfer enables the masked_depth ARM FEED (a 2nd full-res render), stretching wall time to ~16x per sim-second overall and ~30x during collect. The single-threaded host executor is so starved by the 2nd render that the plan-ACCEPT action callback is not serviced within the ~25 s WALL deadline (self.timeout) even though move_group is alive and barely a sim-second has passed. The WALL deadline then false-tripped _should_deadline_crash_retry (any wall plan-deadline -> assume crash+respawn). sim-robust-plan-deadline-pacing-v1 measures the deadline on the SIM clock (RESTOCK_PLAN_SIM_DEADLINE_S, default 30 sim-s): a render-paced slow plan passes little sim-time and waits; a genuinely hung planner still fails after the bounded sim budget (and the untouched WALL planning_wall_exceeded / PLAN_TOTAL_WALL_CAP_S backstop). _should_deadline_crash_retry now also REQUIRES the move_group action server to be GONE (positive death evidence) before treating a fired deadline as a crash.
_how_to_run: scripts/run_mobile_restock.py ... --stop-after collect, fully-honest live_pose + masked_depth arm feed (the coldlive4 stress), NO injection. The STOW is the last collect move so a collect-only run exercises the whole pick->carry->place->stow planning sequence under the heavy arm-feed render pacing -- the exact pacing that false-tripped coldlive4. One GPU run at a time through flock /tmp/aile-gpu.lock, never --force; do not touch the whispr service (pid 1339, ~2.2 GB VRAM). The validator may be holding the GPU -- do not take it.
_pass: PASS = NO false plan-result/plan-accept crash-retry and collect COMPLETES. Concretely: host-stack.log shows NO 'MOVE_GROUP_CRASH_RETRY plan-result wall-deadline' line that is NOT preceded by a real 'process has died ... move_group ... exit code -6' (i.e. no crash-retry without a death), and the collect stage reaches 'succeeded transport_ready=True' without a terminal 'MANIP_HOST_FAILED ... host emergency stop' or 'arm command heartbeat lost'. A render-paced slow plan may log 'MOVE_DEADLINE_FAULT clock=sim state=plan_accept|plan_result' only if the plan genuinely exceeded RESTOCK_PLAN_SIM_DEADLINE_S sim-seconds (a true hang) -- that is the bounded honest failure, not the coldlive4 false crash-retry. If a REAL move_group SIGABRT occurs, it must recover via the server-down path (MOVE_GROUP_CRASH_RETRY 'awaiting respawn' / 'op-phase fault ... action server gone') exactly as PR 225/227 provide -- NOT via a wall-deadline guess.
_what_to_grep: grep -nE 'process has died|exit code -6' host-stack.log                         # REAL move_group deaths (expect 0 in the clean proof)
grep -n 'MOVE_DEADLINE_FAULT clock=wall .* state=plan' host-stack.log           # MUST be ABSENT: planning deadlines are now SIM-clock
grep -n 'MOVE_GROUP_CRASH_RETRY plan-result wall-deadline' host-stack.log       # MUST be ABSENT unless a real death preceded it (the coldlive4 false trip)
grep -nE 'MOVE_DEADLINE_FAULT clock=sim .* state=(plan_accept|plan_result)' host-stack.log  # a plan-state sim miss = a TRUE hang past RESTOCK_PLAN_SIM_DEADLINE_S, not render pacing
grep -nE 'MANIP_HOST_FAILED .* host emergency stop|arm command heartbeat lost' <mission-console>.log   # MUST be ABSENT
_no_required_config_key: The fix is ALWAYS-ON in scripts/twin/restock_manipulation/ros_adapter.py (RosMotionPort._arm_plan_deadline) and the no-crash path is byte-identical in outcome (a healthy plan resolves well within both the old wall and the new sim budget). No mission runtime-config key is needed. Backward-compatible env override below.

_suggested_env.RESTOCK_PLAN_SIM_DEADLINE_S: optional (default 30). The SIM-clock budget for a planning phase (ik/plan_accept/plan_result). Healthy planning consumes ~1-2 sim-s even at ~30x pacing, so 30 is >15x margin; raise only if a legitimately slow plan is observed to exceed it. Clamped [5, 600].
_suggested_env.RESTOCK_PLAN_WALL_CAP_S: keep the sim value (the render-paced plan-DELIVERY wall widen, e.g. 180) -- this is the UNCHANGED WALL genuine-process-hang backstop (planning_wall_exceeded), independent of the sim deadline above.
_suggested_env.RESTOCK_MOVE_DEADLINE_RETRY_MAX: optional (default 2). A plan-state SIM-deadline miss is a render-pacing transient the controller re-issues this many times (fresh plan) before the honest e-stop; leave default.
_suggested_env.RESTOCK_COLLECT_GROUND_TRUTH: UNSET for the faithful honest/live_pose carry (coldlive4), or 1 for a faster deterministic carry+stow

_orthogonal_to: movegroup-estop-retry-collect-fragment.json (real-death recovery, PR 225) and movegroup-respawn-collect-fragment.json (PR 224 mid-carry re-attach). This lane removes the FALSE crash-retry on a healthy-but-render-paced-slow plan; those lanes recover a REAL death. Both run cleanly together.
